name: output-page-gap

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan (pages land at E5)

description: A page never spans a gap (C1 decision 3; 5.48; F15): GET /sessions/{id}/output returns whole output frames below before_seq, and when output was lost right before the page's first byte it sets TSB-Page-Gap: true. The page still starts at a parser-ground point, so the body is a whole-page slice a surface can render. Published e2 so the web lane may build against it; required green at e5, where a core ring first exists (no core ring at E2). The live shape is graded by U2, owed by the E2 core plan.
